codec_layout_dry_run.reason: The attempted oracle reconstructed a supposed P9B model, but the historical P9B pruning helper was proven to be a no-op. Its CPU Q5 code choice also did not match the historical CUDA code choice. The attempt is retained only under failed_attempts.

conclusion: No valid P9D-1 exactness pass can be issued because P9B did not establish a pruned logical model. GaugePack remains a representation hypothesis, not an experimentally authorized branch.
required_next_step: Run P9B-R with true in-place masked_fill_ pruning through calibration, validation and test. Only a quality pass may reopen the CUDA GaugePack codec/oracle.
claim_boundary: This is a methodological closure and bug finding, not a GaugePack codec pass, quality pass, kernel result, full-bank result, throughput result, 80B result, or novelty claim.
